create.name: William Lee Rand
create.bio:
William Lee Rand has practised Reiki since 1981 and became a Reiki Master in 1989, receiving master-level training from several teachers in the United States and Japan, among them Bethel Phaigh, one of Hawayo Takata's masters, and Chiyoko Yamaguchi, who had trained with Chujiro Hayashi. Before devoting himself to Reiki full time he worked in astrology, hypnotherapy and past-life regression. In 1989 he put together the Usui/Tibetan approach, in 1995 he and a group of students developed Karuna Reiki, and in 2014 he introduced Holy Fire Reiki, which has since gone through several revisions. He has written Reiki, The Healing Touch and co-written The Spirit of Reiki.

He founded the International Center for Reiki Training, based in Southfield, Michigan, along with the Reiki Membership Association and the Center for Reiki Research, and edits Reiki News Magazine. The centre licenses teachers who run hundreds of classes a year. Rand still teaches Holy Fire Reiki I and II, master and Karuna classes himself, both live online and in person in Michigan, Glastonbury and on Mount Kurama in Japan. He speaks at the centre's annual retreat and at gatherings such as Omega's Reiki conference, and leads a monthly worldwide practice of sending Reiki to his World Peace Crystal Grids.

books.title: Reiki The Healing Touch
books.author: William Lee Rand
books.description: Rand's long-running manual for first and second degree students, used as the course book in his centre's classes. It sets out where Reiki came from, how attunements and the symbols are understood, and the hand positions for working on oneself and others, together with Japanese techniques.

books.title: The Spirit of Reiki: From Tradition to the Present Fundamental Lines of Transmission, Original Writings, Mastery, Symbols, Treatments, Reiki as a Spiritual Path in Life, and Much More
books.author: Walter Lübeck, Frank Arjava Petter, William Lee Rand
books.description: Three teachers from different Reiki schools pool what they know about the system's lineages, early documents, symbols and ways of practising. It reads as a reference for practitioners who want to understand how the tradition developed and how it is taught today.

courses.title: The Wisdom of Reiki Conference
courses.description: A weekend gathering on Omega's Rhinebeck campus where Rand gives the opening talk and a Holy Fire Reiki session, joined by six other teachers including Brett Bevell, Llyn Roberts and Donnabelle Casis. Sessions mix hands-on practice, talks on Reiki history and a shamanic journey, and beginners are welcome.

courses.title: Usui/Holy Fire III Online Reiki I & II
courses.description: A two-day live online beginners' class taught by Rand from Southfield, covering both first and second degree in one go. Students learn the history and ideals of Reiki, receive the attunements and practise giving sessions to themselves and others.

courses.title: Usui/Holy Fire III Online Reiki Master
courses.description: A three-day live online master-level training led by Rand that prepares students to teach Reiki, both online and face to face. It includes the Holy Fire III attunement and his method for giving attunements over video.

courses.title: 2027 ICRT International Reiki Retreat
courses.description: The centre's yearly retreat, moving in 2027 to Mount Madonna Center near Watsonville, California, with Rand as keynote speaker. Practitioners of any lineage gather for talks, Reiki history, an energy session and shared practice, and an online ticket is offered for those who cannot travel.
courses.price: Online $333 USD early bird, $444 USD from 1 Apr 2027; in-person with lodging from $1363 USD
